what_happened: The task amendment assumed the positive direction (prior findings reaching a later task) would need a new artifact-walker shared with the negative-direction sweep. Research found scripts/memory-harvest.sh already implements the needed mechanism (reads memory_candidates from state.json, confidence-gates, writes to the vault memory-retrieve.sh already injects at every dispatch preflight) but is 'presently uncalled' per its own header -- skill-todo's Stage 7 duplicates the logic inline instead of calling it, scoped only to /todo's completed-task archival batch. Ruled: wire memory-harvest.sh as an immediate per-dispatch call instead of building new ledger/matcher infra, avoiding the escape-hatch spawn entirely.
